OFFER TO PURCHASE FOR CASH
Any and All of its Outstanding
7.250% Senior Notes due 2029
of ASHFORD MIDSTREAM PARTNERS LP

The Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on October 22, 2026.

Ashford Midstream Partners LP is offering to purchase for cash any and all of its outstanding 7.250% Senior Notes due 2029 at a purchase price of $1,012.50 per $1,000 principal amount. The Partnership also has common units and preferred units outstanding, none of which are subject to this Offer.

Odd Lots. Holders of fewer than 100 Notes who tender all of their Notes will have them accepted for payment before proration of the Notes tendered by other holders.
